queries.pg: SELECT MIN(Latitude) AS MinLat, MAX(Latitude) AS MaxLat, MIN(Longitude) AS MinLon, MAX(Longitude) AS MaxLon FROM AISInput

queries.duck: WITH Target AS (SELECT Geom, t FROM AISInput WHERE MMSI = 219015442 ORDER BY t DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT other.MMSI, other.t, ST_AsText(other.Geom) AS Geom FROM AISInput other, Target t WHERE other.MMSI <> 219015442 AND ST_Distance_Sphere(other.Geom, t.Geom) <= 1000 AND ABS(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (other.t - t.t))) <= 60
queries.pg: WITH Target AS (SELECT Geom, t FROM AISInput WHERE MMSI = 219015442 ORDER BY t DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT other.MMSI, other.t, ST_AsText(other.Geom) AS Geom FROM AISInput other, Target t WHERE other.MMSI <> 219015442 AND ST_DistanceSphere(other.Geom, t.Geom) <= 1000 AND ABS(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (other.t - t.t))) <= 60

queries.duck: WITH Latest AS (SELECT MMSI, geom, t FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY MMSI ORDER BY t DESC) AS RowNo FROM AISInput) WHERE RowNo = 1), Neighbors AS (SELECT l1.MMSI AS MMSI1, l2.MMSI AS MMSI2 FROM Latest l1, Latest l2 WHERE l1.MMSI <> l2.MMSI AND ST_Distance_Sphere(l1.Geom, l2.Geom) <= 1000 AND ABS(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (l1.t - l2.t))) <= 60) SELECT l.MMSI, ST_AsText(l.Geom) AS Geom, COUNT(n.MMSI2) AS NeighborCount FROM Latest l LEFT JOIN Neighbors n ON l.MMSI = n.MMSI1 GROUP BY l.MMSI, l.Geom ORDER BY NeighborCount DESC
queries.pg: WITH Latest AS (SELECT MMSI, geom, t FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY MMSI ORDER BY t DESC) AS RowNo FROM AISInput) AS a WHERE RowNo = 1), Neighbors AS (SELECT l1.MMSI AS MMSI1, l2.MMSI AS MMSI2 FROM Latest l1, Latest l2 WHERE l1.MMSI <> l2.MMSI AND ST_DistanceSphere(l1.Geom, l2.Geom) <= 1000 AND ABS(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (l1.t - l2.t))) <= 60) SELECT l.MMSI, ST_AsText(l.Geom) AS Geom, COUNT(n.MMSI2) AS NeighborCount FROM Latest l LEFT JOIN Neighbors n ON l.MMSI = n.MMSI1 GROUP BY l.MMSI, l.Geom ORDER BY NeighborCount DESC

queries.duck: WITH Latest AS (SELECT MMSI, geom, t FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY MMSI ORDER BY t DESC) AS RowNo FROM AISInput) WHERE RowNo = 1), Target AS (SELECT MMSI, geom, t FROM Latest WHERE MMSI = 219015442) SELECT o.MMSI, ST_AsText(o.geom) AS geom, ST_Distance_Sphere(o.geom, t.geom) AS Distance, ABS(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (o.t - t.t))) AS TimeDiff FROM Latest o JOIN Target t ON o.MMSI <> t.MMSI WHERE ST_Distance_Sphere(o.geom, t.geom) <= 1000 AND ABS(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (o.t - t.t))) <= 60 ORDER BY Distance LIMIT 5
queries.pg: WITH Latest AS (SELECT MMSI, geom, t FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY MMSI ORDER BY t DESC) AS RowNo FROM AISInput) AS a WHERE RowNo = 1), Target AS (SELECT MMSI, geom, t FROM Latest WHERE MMSI = 219015442) SELECT o.MMSI, ST_AsText(o.geom) AS geom, ST_DistanceSphere(o.geom, t.geom) AS Distance, ABS(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (o.t - t.t))) AS TimeDiff FROM Latest o JOIN Target t ON o.MMSI <> t.MMSI WHERE ST_DistanceSphere(o.geom, t.geom) <= 1000 AND ABS(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (o.t - t.t))) <= 60 ORDER BY Distance LIMIT 5
